summary: Verified Binance 'configured()' fix. With BINANCE_API_KEY/BINANCE_API_SECRET empty in backend/.env: GET /api/crypto/admin/settings returns api_configured=false, PATCH {enabled:true} is blocked with 400, GET /api/crypto/config returns available=false, POST /api/orders with payment_method='binance' returns 409 ('indisponible'). Admin UI /admin/paiements/binance shows the red warning text in [data-testid='binance-api-status']. All 49 unit tests (test_binance_configured, test_binance_crypto, test_payment_fees) pass. Added preview-URL regression suite (5/5 pass). GET /api/payments/config still 200 (MVola/Orange/manual untouched).
critical_code_review_comments: services/binance.configured() now correctly validates HMAC format (64 alnum, >=16 distinct chars) and rejects placeholder markers — good defensive check.
Suggest also guarding the frontend to call GET /api/crypto/admin/settings for api_configured (already done) rather than reading env — current implementation matches this.
seed_data_creation: None (binance order attempt rejected before persistence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview .env has BINANCE_API_KEY/BINANCE_API_SECRET empty — do not fill with placeholders ('dummy', 'preview', etc.) because configured() will correctly treat them as unconfigured. To simulate configured state in tests, monkeypatch services.binance.configured (see test_binance_crypto.py).
rca of the issue: Original bug: committed backend/.env had placeholder BINANCE keys ('preview-dummy-not-a-real-key'), and configured() only checked non-empty, so admin UI falsely reported 'Clés API configurées côté serveur' on Render. Fix validates real HMAC format + rejects placeholder markers. Verified end-to-end on preview.
